newsitem.title: USA: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear plant up to 89 pct, rising.
newsitem.headline: Wash. 1,158 MW nuclear plant up to 89 pct, rising.

text.p: Washington Public Power Supply System's 1,158 megawatt (MW) nuclear plant was back to 89 percent capacity after briefly ramping down to 54 percent overnight, spokesman Richared Romanelli said Wednesday.
Work to correct a problem with the motor for the plant's adjustable speed drive began Saturday morning, but power was reduced further late Tuesday for testing of the system, he said.
The plant, WNP-2, was expected to reach 100 percent by 1200 PST/1500 EST.
It is scheduled to shut for a 42-day refueling period on April 12.

Last year, WNP-2 was taken out of service between March and early July at the request of the Bonneville Power Administration (BPA), which markets the plant's electricity output, because supplies of cheaper-to-produce hydropower were overly abundant.
WNP-2 has not yet heard from BPA on any changes to this year's outage schedule, Romanelli said.
